scope: Recorded large-scale mixed TET4/WEDGE6/HEX8 evidence for the conforming linear_static route in one declared environment; no accuracy, production, precision, modal, dynamic, nonlinear or universal performance claim.

model.topology: Repeated conforming three-family chains; each chain is one TET4, one WEDGE6 and one HEX8 with a shared triangular TET4/WEDGE6 interface and shared quadrilateral WEDGE6/HEX8 interface.
model.analysis: small-strain linear isotropic elasticity; fixed x=0 DOFs; unit total Z load per chain distributed on free top nodes; SI units
model.interfaces: nodal conforming only; no hanging nodes, MPC transition, PYRAMID5 or HEX8-SRI

environment.backend: SciPy sparse linear solver as selected by the standard mixed LinearStaticSolver
environment.solver_assumption: assume_spd=true; justified by homogeneous small-strain isotropic elasticity with complete per-chain Dirichlet constraints
environment.preallocation: record actual exposed backend diagnostics; do not infer unavailable allocator details

reproducibility.comparison: input digest, displacement digest, iterations, residual, equilibrium and energy; runtime/memory excluded from exact physics digest

non_goals: No PYRAMID5, HEX8-SRI, modal, dynamic, nonlinear or nonconforming scope.
No 1M or 3M blocker if resources are not budgeted; those runs are optional and must not be fabricated.
